title: Church Unity
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains church unity (different people one in Christ) and the teaching of 1 Corinthians 12:12 (one body, many parts), Galatians 3:28 (all one in Christ) and Matthew 16:18 (Jesus builds his church), and how unity brings harmony.

floor.prerequisite: Knows how the early church lived in unity.
floor.question: What did the early believers devote themselves to?
floor.answer: The apostles' teaching, fellowship, breaking bread and prayer

representations: a body outline with many parts
cards of groups in a church
contexts: Christians of different churches at a joint service

board.do: Draw a body with many parts.
Point at the hand and the foot.
board.say: Are these the same? Are they one body?

board.do: Wait for the child to say different parts, one body.

misconceptions.ask: What does unity in the church mean?
misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Corinthians 12:12: one body, many parts. A body needs different parts.

misconceptions.ask: In Matthew 16:18 Jesus says "I will build my..."
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 16:18 and ask: can a building be built on a person's faith? The church is the people.

listen_for: Some are more important than others
misconceptions.ask: What does Galatians 3:28 say about tribe or status?
misconceptions.repair: Read Galatians 3:28 and list groups: tribe, rich and poor, men and women: all one in Christ.

misconceptions.ask: Are Christians in a different church from yours part of the body of Christ?
misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Corinthians 12:12-13: one body. Name churches in the area and say what they share.

checks.question: What does Galatians 3:28 say about status?
checks.answer: All are one in Christ Jesus

checks.question: What does church unity mean?
checks.answer: Different people working together as one in Christ
